annotations.title: Best mix and deco gases for a depth

altitude.description: Surface altitude (m or ft, per units), 0 to 10000 m (32800 ft). Default 0.

depth.description: Target (maximum) depth in m (metric) or ft (imperial). Required.

ppo2_max.description: PPO₂ limit in bar at the target depth, 1.0 to 1.6. Default 1.4, a working bottom-gas limit.

style.description: auto (default): nitrox when it meets target_end, else trimix. nitrox: no helium, END reported but not enforced. trimix: the standard fill comes from the trimix list.

target_end.description: Deepest equivalent narcotic depth (END) allowed at depth, in m or ft. Helium is added to meet it. Default 30 m (98 ft).

temperature.description: Water temperature for gas density, in °C (metric, -2 to 40) or °F (imperial, 28 to 104). Default 15 °C.

units.description: metric (m, bar, L, °C) or imperial (ft, psi, ft³, °F): the unit system for every value in and out. Default metric.

water.description: Water type, from its density: en13319 (EN 13319, the dive computer standard) 10.00 m per bar, salt 9.95, fresh 10.20, red_sea 9.92. Default en13319.

name: best_mix

best_mix.description: Richest mix: O₂ floored to a whole percent, He rounded up to 0.1 (0 for nitrox).

density_g_l.description: Gas density at the target depth, g/L to 0.1, at temperature (default 15 °C).

helium_pct_for_density_limit.description: Only when density is over 5.2 g/L: the total helium % (O₂ unchanged) that brings it to 5.2 g/L at the target depth. null when under 5.2, or when no helium fraction can.

mod.description: MOD at cap_used_bar, whole m or ft, floored.

deco_ladder.description: Standard travel and deco gases for this depth; empty to 30 m (100 ft).

switch_depth.description: travel: where to switch to the bottom mix on the descent. deco and oxygen: where to switch on the ascent.

spoken_summary.description: A few plain sentences for a voice reply, ending with an offer: digits allowed, no symbols or notation.

standard_mix.description: Nearest standard fill (air, EANx28 to EANx50, 25/25 to 10/70) within the same PPO₂ and END limits at this depth.

density_g_l.description: Gas density at the target depth, g/L to 0.1, at temperature (default 15 °C).

helium_pct_for_density_limit.description: Only when density is over 5.2 g/L: the total helium % (O₂ unchanged) that brings it to 5.2 g/L at the target depth. null when under 5.2, or when no helium fraction can.

mod.description: MOD at cap_used_bar, whole m or ft, floored.

units.description: metric (m, bar, L, °C) or imperial (ft, psi, ft³, °F): the unit system for every value in and out. Default metric.
